thig6.6:1.1: buddha vīra namo ty atthu sabbasattānam uttama | yo maṃ dukkhā pamocesi aññañ ca bahukaṃ janaṃ. || ||
thig6.6:2.1: sabbadukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ hetutaṇhā visositā | ariyaṭṭhaṅgiko maggo nirodho phusito mayā. || ||
thig6.6:3.1: mātā putto pitā bhātā ayyikā ca pure ahuṃ | yathābhuccam ajānantī saṃsari 'haṃ anibbisaṃ. || ||
thig6.6:4.1: diṭṭho hi me so bhagavā antimo 'yaṃ samussayo | vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. || ||
thig6.6:5.1: āraddhaviriye pahitatte niccaṃ daḷhaparakkame | samagge sāvake passa esā buddhāna vandanā. || ||
thig6.6:6.1: bahūnaṃ vata atthāya Māyā janayi Gotamaṃ | byādhimaraṇatunnānaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ byapānudi. || ||
